requirements.value: Bachelor's in Computer Science or in a comparable Bachelor's programme
requirements.sourceQuote: Applicants need a Bachelor's in Computer Science or in a comparable Bachelor's programme.

The Bachelor's programme should contain at least 20 credits in Software Engineering, at least 20 credits in Theoretical Computer Science, at least 15 credits in Technical Informatics and at least 15 credits in Basic Mathematics of Computer Science.
